snippet.title: The Cursed Garden - Indie Horror Game - No Commentary
snippet.description:
Thanks For Watching!

Facebook https://www.facebook.com/Stella-Abbasi-100150965166877/
Twitter https://twitter.com/StellaAbbasi

Download https://amine-developer.itch.io/the-cursed-garden

About the game
I was an ordinary caretaker of a quiet garden, routine nights, sounds of nature, and nothing to worry about...

Until he came that night.

Strange sounds, shadows moving on their own, and symbols carved into trees that never existed before.

The calm turned into a nightmare. And the garden...is no longer what it was.

Indie Horror Game Playlist https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLk0tZ0YT3FZEsIgd3Qdj19xGe9VcMMI1P

#thecursedgarden #Indiegames
